result:
I’d make **universal, high-quality education that teaches critical thinking, empathy, and practical agency** available to every person.

Why that one change? It compounds. People who can reason clearly, understand others’ perspectives, and believe they can act effectively are better equipped to solve poverty, health, conflict, environmental damage, and inequality—not because education magically fixes everything, but because it gives more people the tools to fix their own part of the world.
